value.title: claude-session-start-adopt
value.summary: A hand-started Claude gets its pij seat automatically at session start — no `/pij ready` — via a once-per-session Claude SessionStart hook that pij installs; the statusline stays read-only.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Jordan 2026-09-02: 'if Claude does not have a pij seat, register for one in its current seat so I do not have to type /pij ready; Claude just loads with a pij id.' Investigation (prime subagent, file:line): the statusline (~/.claude/statusline-context.sh:37-51) is READ-ONLY — `pij whoami` parsed for the ⛓ id; it never adopts; what Jordan saw appear today is pane-based resolution now working (identity.rs:698-728). Adopting FROM the statusline is wrong: it runs on every render (~300ms throttle), on the render path, and a non-tmux Claude would fail every render. The right mechanism is a Claude **SessionStart hook** (fires once per session, off the hot path, sees CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID; the slot is free in ~/.claude/settings.json). rs adopt is already idempotent on a live-owned pane (identity.rs:470-480 adopts INTO the existing owner), so a second session in the same pane does not mint a second id. Legacy TS adopt is only partially idempotent (cli.ts:2952-2967 via pendingPaneOccupant) — not in scope, adopt routes to rs.

sections.name: goals
value: G1 Hook script shipped in the repo (e.g. harness/scripts/claude-session-start-pij.sh or a `pij-rs hook session-start` verb): if $TMUX_PANE is set and the rs daemon answers, run `pij adopt "$TMUX_PANE" --harness claude` (idempotent); print nothing on success except what Claude's hook contract allows; on refusal/no-tmux/no-daemon exit 0 silently with one line to a log, never block session start.

G2 Installer: extend plan 126's ensure path (crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs, same backup + additive-JSON discipline) to ALSO ensure a SessionStart hook entry pointing at the shipped script in every Claude home; idempotent; `pij-rs doctor claude-hook` reports state; run at daemon boot alongside the accept ensure.

G3 Statusline stays read-only; guard its pij block with `[ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ]` so non-tmux sessions skip the node spawn (the statusline script lives in ~/.claude; the installer may patch ONLY that guard, with backup, or the plan documents the one-line operator edit — PM decides and records).
G4 The adopted seat gets consent stamped (s121) so the very first inbound message lands as a real turn.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No change to legacy TS adopt idempotence (req-0026 family).
No change to /pij ready (it remains valid and becomes a no-op when the hook already adopted).

value.text: LIVE: with the hook installed, hand-start `claude` in a fresh tmux window and type NOTHING; within a few seconds the statusline shows ⛓ <id>, `pij-rs list` shows the seat bound to that pane with cross_session_inbound_accept=true, and a message from another seat lands as a real turn. Pane transcript + spine rows pasted.
LIVE: start a second `claude` in the SAME pane after closing the first (or run the hook twice) → same id or a clean re-adopt, never two live ids for one pane.
LIVE: start `claude` OUTSIDE tmux → session starts normally, no error shown, hook log records the skip.

Unit: installer adds the SessionStart hook entry without disturbing existing hooks (Notification/PreToolUse/PostToolUse preserved byte-for-byte), backup written, second run no-op; malformed settings refused. RED-first.
`/pij ready` typed after auto-adopt reports the existing id (no second seat). cargo/typecheck/harness checks green.

value.title: Hook + installer + live proof
value.brief: Ship the hook script, extend the installer, prove AC1-AC5, PR into main.
